attributes.addressDerivation: CREATE2 from the launcher, with the salt mined until the address carries exactly the declared permission bits; the constructor validates its own bits so a mis-mined salt reverts the launch
attributes.summary: The one immutable hook bound to the canonical dynamic-fee PoolKey. It binds exactly one pool once at afterInitialize, returns a per-swap LP-fee override computed from the pool's own EWMA realized volatility, and accrues the mandatory Programmable volume fee on the executed gross quote-side amount across all four swap quadrants.

attributes.callerRestriction: deployAndLaunch reverts unless msg.sender is the launch wallet fixed in the constructor, and reverts on any second call
attributes.residualBalance: every unspent unit of both currencies is returned to the launch wallet before the transaction ends
attributes.summary: Single-use launcher. One transaction deploys the token, deploys the hook at the mined address, initialises the canonical dynamic-fee pool, seeds one full-range position and settles both currencies; any mismatch reverts the whole transaction.

attributes.addressDerivation: CREATE2 from the launcher, with the salt mined until the predicted address sorts above the WETH9 address so WETH is currency0 and the launched token is currency1
attributes.summary: Fixed-supply ERC-20 minted once in its constructor to the launcher. No owner, minter, pauser, blacklist, transfer tax, rebase, upgrade path or rescue function exists.

attributes.ordering: after the token, so the mined hook salt commits both sorted currencies
first, so its address fixes the PoolKey currency ordering

attributes.failureRule: a foreign key member, a mismatched start price, an unexpected delta or an over-budget settlement reverts the whole launch
attributes.steps: PoolManager.initialize on the canonical dynamic-fee key, then afterInitialize binds the pool and sets the base fee, then unlock and modifyLiquidity for one full-range position, then sync, transfer and settle for each owed currency
